summary: Accomplished researcher specializing in Remote Sensing, GIS, and Climate Science with extensive experience in satellite data analysis, machine learning applications for environmental monitoring, and geospatial modeling. Strong background in drought monitoring, snow cover mapping, air quality analysis, and land-atmosphere interactions. Proficient in Python, R, Google Earth Engine, and various remote sensing tools.

education.degree: PGD (Post Graduate Diploma) in Remote Sensing and GIS

responsibilities: Conducting research on land-atmosphere interaction during thunderstorms over major urban areas of India
Utilizing high-resolution mesoscale modeling framework and climatological datasets
Analyzing weather patterns and their impacts on urban environments

experience.organization: Department of Remote Sensing and GIS, Vidyasagar University
responsibilities: Developed ML models for prediction of agricultural droughts using subseasonal to seasonal forecasting
Conducted long-term monitoring of droughts using satellite-based indices
Estimated crop yield reduction using machine learning approaches
Organized National Workshop on Drought Monitoring and Early Warning using Geospatial Techniques

experience.organization: DST-Mahamana Centre of Excellence in Climate Change Research, BHU
responsibilities: Analyzed horizontal and vertical distribution of air pollutants over Indo-Gangetic plain
Utilized ground-based and satellite observations for air quality monitoring
Presented research on aerosol vertical distribution using CALIPSO LIDAR at AAPW-5
Mapped snow cover area of Northwest Himalaya using MODIS, Sentinel, and Landsat datasets
Implemented analysis using Google Earth Engine platform
Installed and supervised automatic weather stations, snow precipitation gauges, and snow pack analyzers
Contributed to EOAM project on Mountain Ecosystem and Water Resource monitoring

experience.organization: CSIR - Institute of Himalayan Bioresource Technology
responsibilities: Created spectral library of forest tree species found in Himalayan Region
